# Test MDX-style layout components.

md2html -html output -html-ext html testsite
exists output/README.html

# Group wrapper carries the column count from the brace expression.
grep 'class="md-card-group" data-cols="3"' output/README.html

# Cards render with their titles, and an href wraps the title in a link.
grep 'class="md-card"' output/README.html
grep '<div class="md-card-title">Install</div>' output/README.html
grep 'class="md-card-link" href="/install"' output/README.html

# Card bodies are Markdown, not raw text.
grep '<code>go install</code>' output/README.html
grep '<strong>config.yaml</strong>' output/README.html
grep '<li>one</li>' output/README.html

# A card without cols falls back to the default group width.
grep 'data-cols="2"' output/README.html

# CSS for the components ships with the page.
grep '\.md-card-group ' output/README.html

rm -rf testsite output

# Invalid component usage warns and is skipped, without aborting the
# render or emitting unstyled markup.
md2html -html output -html-ext html badsite
exists output/README.html

grep 'later content' output/README.html
! grep 'class="md-card"' output/README.html

stderr 'components: parse error'
stderr 'file=README.md'
stderr 'unknown component <Widget>'
stderr 'missing required attribute'
stderr 'no attribute'

rm -rf badsite output

# An unclosed component is reported but still renders, closing at end of
# input the way an unclosed HTML element does, so the body is not lost.
md2html -html output -html-ext html unclosed
exists output/README.html

stderr 'unclosed <Card>, expected </Card>'
stderr 'line=3'
grep 'class="md-card"' output/README.html
grep 'body text' output/README.html

rm -rf unclosed output

-- testsite/README.md --
# Components

<CardGroup cols={3}>

<Card title="Install" href="/install">
Run `go install` to get started.
</Card>

<Card title="Configure">
Edit **config.yaml**.

- one
- two
</Card>

</CardGroup>

<CardGroup>

<Card title="Defaults">
two columns
</Card>

</CardGroup>

-- badsite/README.md --
# Bad components

<Widget/>

<Card/>

<Card title="a" titel="b"/>

later content

-- unclosed/README.md --
# Unclosed

<Card title="never closed">
body text
